root_cause_analysis.gap_scanner_likely_logic: Scanning for: (1) visibility keywords (public/private/protected) (2) namespace declarations (3) scope closures - then flagging when patterns don't align
root_cause_analysis.false_positive_trigger: When gap scanner sees 'namespace' or scope-related keywords, it flags without understanding whether those are CORRECT by C++ standard
